final_hypotheses.title: Walker commuter; Priya the home anchor
final_hypotheses.prose: Elena walks to her office in town, leaving around 7:45 and returning around 17:45 on weekdays. She takes her backpack, laptop, notebook, pen, wallet, keys, hat, jacket, and shoes with her. Critically, she does NOT take her charger (it stays plugged in at desk_b1), her helmet, her bike_lock, or her umbrella—cycling is a weekend-only hobby. Priya stays home: a short walk from 7:00 to 7:30, then the house is hers until an afternoon errand (14:00–16:00) and dinner prep. The dog is fed at 7:30 and 18:00 by whoever is home. Evening TV starts at 19:30 with the remote (on the coffee table) and a mug. What sets this apart from p_7ef3: the helmet and bike_lock are at the entry all day on weekdays, and the charger is at desk_b1 during work hours. What sets this apart from p_1e82: the charger is at desk_b1 (not coffee_table_l1), and the water_bottle_elena rests at dining_table_d1. What would refute it: helmet_elena or bike_lock_elena sighted OUT_OF_HOUSE on a weekday, or charger_elena sighted anywhere other than desk_b1 between 9:00 and 16:00 on a weekday.

What would refute it: charger_elena sighted OUT_OF_HOUSE or at a location other than desk_b1 between 9:00 and 16:00 on a weekday; or umbrella_elena sighted OUT_OF_HOUSE on a weekday.

final_hypotheses.title: Walker commuter; Priya home all week
final_hypotheses.prose: Elena walks to her office, leaving at 8:00 and returning at 17:30. She takes her backpack, wallet, laptop, notebook, pen, charger, and water_bottle. The helmet, bike_lock, and hat stay on the entry hook all week—cycling is a weekend-only hobby. Priya is more active than the baseline: a longer morning walk (7:00–8:00) and a substantial afternoon errand run (13:00–16:30), but she is HOME every evening. She does not go out Wednesday or Friday evenings; she is in the kitchen preparing dinner and watching TV. What changed from p_1e82: the claim that Priya is out Wednesday evening is removed; the evidence shows resident_2 (Priya) in the kitchen at 14:00 and 18:00 on Wednesday. Her glasses and book stay at the nightstand all evening. What sets this apart: Priya is present at the house every evening, and her glasses are at the nightstand (not OUT_OF_HOUSE) from 18:00 onward. What would refute it: Priya's glasses sighted OUT_OF_HOUSE between 19:00 and 21:00 on any weekday, or helmet_elena sighted OUT_OF_HOUSE on a weekday.
